description: This file provides a comprehensive interface and implementation overview of the HDMIOutput HAL, including its architecture, references, capabilities, state machines, and system integration details. It mainly documents the design, functionality, precise capabilities, and operational sequences associated with HDMI output management in a platform.

classes.name: Capabilities
classes.description: Describes supported video formats, pixel formats, colour spaces, HDR modes, and other HDMI capabilities.

classes.name: HDCPStatus
classes.description: Enumerates HDCP authentication states such as authenticated, unauthenticated, or unknown.

classes.name: HDROutputMode
classes.description: Defines HDR output modes such as AUTO, HDR10, HLG, or Dolby Vision.

classes.name: SPDSource
classes.description: Enumerates source product description signal sources like Blu-ray, DVD, PC, etc.

classes.name: VIC
classes.description: Defines HDMI Video ID Codes representing various supported resolutions and refresh rates.

classes.name: ResourceId
classes.description: Unique identifier for each HDMI output resource.

classes.name: HDMIOutput
classes.description: Represents an individual HDMI output port, its capabilities, and controls.

classes.name: PlatformCapabilities
classes.description: Static properties representing the platform's maximum HDMI support capabilities, e.g., resolutions, HDR, advanced features.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves the capabilities supported by the HDMI output, such as video formats, colorimetry, HDR modes, and features.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Configures HDMI output parameters like VIC, content type, HDR mode, AFD, etc.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and begins HDMI output configuration and signal transmission.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops HDMI output signal and releases resources.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the HDMI output port, stops signals, and deregisters as needed.

methods.name: getHDCPCurrentVersion
methods.description: Returns the currently negotiated HDCP protocol version.

methods.name: getHDCPReceiverVersion
methods.description: Returns the HDCP version supported by the connected sink device.
